referenceData.instructions: A fictional service business with four authored complete arrangements and one standardized package. Edit the explicit case values; adapt the app for other arrangements, payment structures, activity dependencies or services.
Prefilled values are fictional examples. Changing part of the workbook can leave example inputs in the case.
Edit the named input sheets. Keep worksheet names, column headers and record identifiers. Do not add formulas. Other case inputs remain unchanged.

Whole elapsed days from the declared planning origin; event order distinguishes payments within a day. Monetary inputs use integer USD cents, displayed as dollars where labelled. Opening cash is unrestricted incremental growth funding after existing obligations. Reserve funds are deducted by the cash-balance requirement once. Forecast sales and collection dates are supplied assumptions, not predictions.
Upload this workbook, inspect the changes and diagnostics, then apply. Importing does not calculate results or establish operating permission.
